sources.entry: Invidious ⚠ - Alternative YouTube front-end. (Demo) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Crystal
Invidious | Privacy-friendly alternative front-end to YouTube

summary.one_liner: Invidious is an open source, privacy-focused alternative front-end to YouTube that serves videos without ads, tracking, or JavaScript.
summary.what_it_does: Invidious is a YouTube front-end that lets users watch videos, manage subscriptions, and see notifications for subscribed channels without using Google accounts. It offers an audio-only mode with background play on mobile, light and dark themes, and support for YouTube comments. Users can import subscriptions and watch history from YouTube, NewPipe, and FreeTube, and export subscriptions to NewPipe and FreeTube. The README also mentions embedded video support, a developer API, and that the project does not use official YouTube APIs. Public instances can be picked from a list, or the software can be self-hosted by following the installation instructions.
use_cases: watch YouTube without ads or tracking
import YouTube subscriptions into NewPipe or FreeTube
embed YouTube-style videos through a privacy-friendly player
how_to_run: Select a public instance from the Invidious instances list and start watching videos
Follow the installation instructions in the official documentation to host your own instance
notable: Works without JavaScript and without a Google account
Does not use official YouTube APIs
Imports and exports subscriptions and history with NewPipe and FreeTube
Browser extension Privacy Redirect is recommended to route YouTube links to an instance
caveats: The README disclaims liability for third-party instances and misuse such as illegal downloading
Hosting details are only in the external documentation, not the README
